gaps.evidence: Official UI omits test source for official competitions; GET first-competition--ticket-booking/tests returned 404. Published count is five.
All three initial-projects-download endpoints returned 409: This competition does not inherit initial projects.
Lite/Web Python ARC starter endpoints returned 404. Public demo-agent ZIP was downloaded separately; it is not asserted equivalent to ARC.
No server source or evaluator download was exposed in the inspected client. Public /openapi.json returned SPA HTML; /api/openapi.json returned 404.

gaps.component: Execution image, server clock injection, test runtime settings, model proxy and scoring
gaps.evidence: Public scaffold and task prose expose only partial contracts; no exact evaluation container, fixture/clock injection implementation or billing/scoring backend source was provided.
Offline Playwright 1.64.1 collection finds Lite 27 vs published 28; full 66 vs published 67. All API files were preserved. Exact cause or any unpublished case is unknown; not scored as complete.

assertions_policy: Official inputs and acceptance source preserved as bytes; fixtures contain published benchmark identities, not private session credentials.
